h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Agartala

items.pText: Agartala sits close to the Bangladesh border, about 1,960 km from our factory in Vasai. That is a long way, and it is still within our delivery area. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, housing complexes, government offices and parks in Agartala and across Tripura, and we send every order by road to your site.

Distance changes how you should plan an order. It pays to finalise the full list of equipment, the colours and the layout before dispatch, so everything reaches Agartala in one consignment and installation can begin as soon as it arrives. We share a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and you approve it along with the quote before we start manufacturing. Tripura gets heavy rain for a large part of the year, so tell us about drainage on your plot early. It affects both the base we suggest and the best time to install.

richText.heading: Getting a long-distance order right for Agartala

c: Three things save trouble on a project this far from Vasai. First, check that a loaded truck can reach the site, or tell us how far the equipment must be carried by hand. Second, have the ground ready, levelled and drained, before the equipment arrives. Third, keep one person on your side who can approve small changes quickly by phone.

items.q: Do you really deliver playground equipment to Agartala?
items.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and sent to Agartala by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the region, using grouting or a self-standing base.

items.q: What should we prepare before the equipment reaches our site?
items.a: A cleared, level and well-drained area matching the layout drawing, clear truck access, and a person who can receive the consignment. If the base needs concrete for grouting, we will tell you in advance.

items.q: Is there a best season to install a playground in Tripura?
items.a: Installation is easier in the drier months, since grouting and rubber flooring need dry ground to set well. If you must install during the rains, keep a covered area for the equipment and allow for weather breaks.
